title: Microaeration promotes volatile siloxanes conversion to methane and simpler monomeric products

abstract_evidence_excerpt: Microbial degradation under microaerobic conditions is a promising approach to mitigate D4 and D5 siloxanes while recovering energy in wastewater treatment plants. Results show that the use of microaeration in an otherwise strictly anaerobic environment significantly enhances siloxane conversion to methane.
